sources.snippet: Hothaifa/HEQ-M1.2 is a 31 billion parameter instruction-tuned causal language model developed by Hothaifa. This model is finetuned from unsloth/gemma-4-31b-it-unsloth-bnb-4bit and was trained using Unsloth for accelerated performance. It is designed for general language generation tasks, leveraging its large parameter count for robust understanding and response generation.

sources.snippet: Model Overview Hothaifa/HEQ-S2-1.6.6 is a 31 billion parameter language model, fine-tuned by Hothaifa. It is based on the Gemma 4 architecture and supports a substantial context length of 32768 tokens. This model was developed using an efficient fine-tuning process, leveraging the Unsloth library and Huggingface's TRL library, which reportedly enabled training at twice the speed.
